description:
The frameshift predictive (PRD) step of a frameshift branch (SM 9).

NMD-predicted (yellow) starts at a fixed +6.0 and non-stop decay (green) at
+4.0; the rescue (orange), no-NMD (violet), and extension (green) branches
derive initial points from a table. Positive points are reduced by the SM 18
mechanism/exon matrix.

adjusted_points.description: Coded PRD points after the SM 18 adjustment.
adjusted_points.title: Adjusted Points

alternative_met_rescue.description: Evidence an alternative-Met start codon rescues function (orange branch).
alternative_met_rescue.title: Alternative Met Rescue

basis.description: Predictive basis (e.g. NMD prediction; PTC position).
basis.title: Basis

extension_length_aa.description: Non-native C-terminal amino acids added past the stop (extension branch).
extension_length_aa.title: Extension Length Aa

initial_points.description: Initial PRD points before the SM 18 adjustment.
initial_points.title: Initial Points

non_stop_decay_predicted.description: ORF runs to the polyA with no in-frame stop, predicting NSD (green).
non_stop_decay_predicted.title: Non Stop Decay Predicted

protein_fraction_reduced.description: Fraction of protein lost (the orange/violet initial-points table).
protein_fraction_reduced.title: Protein Fraction Reduced

title: FrameshiftPredictiveEvidence
